experiment.change: Remove experimental.inlineCss while preserving stylesheet rules and order.
experiment.privateSelection: The predeclared first 25 inventory jobs, with no route/role narrowing or score-driven replacement.

decision.reason: The measured byte reduction did not establish an acceptable performance improvement: both group median performance scores declined, all private FCP pairs increased, and two of three public LCP pairs increased.

preparationAttempt.cause: The initial invocation omitted the required --import tsx loader.

measurementEquivalence.projection: All selected logical cases, attempts, statuses, category scores, metrics, observed metrics, network counts/bytes, effective settings, warnings, deltas, distributions and cohort counts.

limits: Only the fixed private first 25 and public three cases are compared; the full 530/620 page inventories are not completed by this experiment.
All selected attempts are preserved; first attempts alone form the paired statistics. No low score was retried or excluded.

The full before private cohort retains 116 attempted, 113 completed, two errors, one timeout and 414 pending. Those adverse cases outside the fixed comparison subset are not relabelled as successful measurements.

The private workspace_entities, workspace_meta and requests component digests differ between cohorts, while locale_releases is equal. Each cohort was individually stable between its recorded start and completion. These digest-only records do not identify changed rows, fields or causes. The public content identity is equal. Declared configuration and host manifest equality do not establish equal instantaneous contention or cache state.
One measured attempt per case does not establish statistical significance, confidence intervals, causality, field performance or INP.
The median of paired after-minus-before changes is distinct from the difference between group medians.
Lighthouse simulated values remain the reported metrics; the separate observed metrics are diagnostics and do not replace them.

Document bytes contain inline CSS and JavaScript. External Stylesheet and Script sums do not separately measure or double-count those inline shares. The retained resourceType accounting is not a complete all-resource bandwidth total.
An accessibility score of 100 is not comprehensive WCAG conformance or a completed manual review; private noindex routes intentionally have lower SEO scores.

This public derivative excludes machine origins/paths, actual fixture or session identifiers and private input fingerprints. Original reports, failed preparation attempts and private provenance remain separately retained.
The rejection decision concerns this global CSS experiment. No later auth-slot or thumbnail change is measured by these results.

privateWorkloadComparison.basis: Retained component digests compared within and between the two cohorts.
privateWorkloadComparison.limits: Digest equality or inequality does not identify changed rows, fields, fixture values, or the cause of a difference.
